email.body1:
John, saw Lavu's 2026 POS AI report and the Marty study across 169 stores that surfaced $1.86M in annual productivity losses.

Data stories that strong usually generate more in-market multi-unit operators than the team can reach before the interest cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Lavu off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for Lavu.

When a report drives a wave of interest, pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Lavu needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for Lavu.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Lavu's reply rate likely compares to other restaurant tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

John, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Capitalizing on a big research push keeps the whole sales org busy for a while.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales motion? I'll tailor it to Lavu either way.
